eps.d: Slice-of-life spoof chronicling typical lager lout and part-time Chuck Norris impersonator Paul Calf's attempts to win back the girl of his dreams, aided and abetted by best pal Fat Bob.

eps.t: Three Fights, Two Weddings And A Funeral
eps.d: Steve Coogan excels, as ever, as Paul - one-part philosopher to two-parts psychopath, and all-round drunken wastrel, liable to come out with such pearls as, "Inside every bag o'shite there's a spark of gold"
